name: abbey-plugin
description: The Drowned Abbey: Canopy state-machine plugin (SPEC §7)

scripts.build:proto: pbjs -t static-module -w commonjs -o src/proto/index.js proto/*.proto && pbts -o src/proto/index.d.ts src/proto/index.js && cp src/proto/index.js src/proto/index.cjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build:rules && npm run build:proto && npm run build:descriptors && npm run build
scripts.build:rules: cd rules && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && npm prune --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund
